description: Regional automated job-search schedules for Chief's Career department. Each region's scheduled launcher (career-ops/run_scheduled_scan.cmd) calls the UNIFIED scheduled orchestrator (career-ops/discovery/scheduled_orchestrator.py run --scheduled --require-live-web, discovery policy high_recall), which combines the structured regional provider scan, the bounded open-web/Codex research pass, Company Watch findings, the owner's priority company watchlist findings and the recruiter-watch / LinkedIn-export intakes into ONE unified funnel + candidate manifest. Schedules run BOUNDED DRY-RUN scans only: they never write a tracker, never apply a manifest and never submit anything. Tracker writes stay an explicit, backed-up, approval-gated step (career_ops_cli.py write --apply). Rollback to the pre-cutover behaviour is one command (see career-ops/scheduled_orchestrator.md).
overlap_policy: Tasks are staggered and each writes a distinct run-health file, so overlapping runs cannot duplicate rows: dry-run scans never mutate state at all, and the deterministic runner keys each run by a hash of its accepted candidate set so a replayed run reports duplicates instead of new rows.

brief.mode: read-only aggregation; writes only the brief artifact under runtime/career-ops/daily-brief
brief.delivery: local file only; no external delivery channel is configured, attempted or assumed healthy
brief.note: The Career Daily Brief / Pipeline Prioritizer (roster B23). Morning time is chosen so the brief exists before the owner's working day; making the artifact available is all the schedule does. Delivering it to a messaging surface is a separate, unverified step (see career-ops/daily_brief_config.json#delivery).
brief.discovery_unified_note: The unified orchestrator writes its whole-company funnel + manifest summary to runtime/career-ops/discovery/latest.json, which is the path this brief's discovery collector reads (career-ops/daily_brief_config.json#discovery.latest).

uk.provider_coverage: 12 global/remote job boards + the owner's own ATS tracked_companies (existing lane, unchanged)
uk.notes: Wires the existing UK lane (portals.yml + data/pipeline.md + data/scan-history.tsv). Matches the historical ~23:48 local run window recorded in data/scan-runs.tsv. Reuses the owner's installation in place; no files are added to it. The scheduled launcher now runs the unified orchestrator (structured regional scan + open-web/Codex research + Company Watch + priority watchlist + recruiter/LinkedIn intakes) in bounded dry-run mode; the structured regional worker is still invoked unchanged inside it.

unified_orchestrator.discovery_policy: high_recall (the owner's Intern/Internship-only rule is available only as an explicit diagnostic: --mode intern_only --compare)
unified_orchestrator.live_requirement: --require-live-web: exits 3 with the blocker recorded when no current-web search mechanism is operational; no fixture fallback is ever accepted as proof
outputs: runtime/career-ops/discovery/latest.json (the artifact the Career Daily Brief reads)
unified_orchestrator.rollback: "%PY%" "%CP%\career-ops\regional_job_search.py" run --region %REGION% --scheduled --timeout 1800 --record "%LOGDIR%" (restore this line in run_scheduled_scan.cmd; the launcher path is unchanged so the scheduled tasks do not need re-registration)
